summary: Compare competitors using current sources, consistent criteria, and evidence-backed trade-offs.
intents: compare our product with the three main competitors
how does our pricing stack up against rivals
build a feature comparison matrix for note-taking apps
what are competitors doing better than us
summarize the competitive landscape for this market
prerequisites: comparison dimensions, geography, and time horizon
verify: Every competitor claim cites a dated source
The same criteria and weights are applied to every competitor
Unknowns are marked rather than guessed
